kustoQueries.title: Last_hour_average_availability
kustoQueries.kustoQuery: cluster('KUSTO_CLUSTER').database('wawsprod').AntaresDataServiceApiTransactions | where TIMESTAMP > ago(90m) | where EventStampName == 'STAMP_NAME' | where OperationName =~ 'GetWorkersForHostName' | where EventId == 65401 | parse RequestUrl with 'https://' DataRoleIP ':' * '/hostnames/' HostName '/webworkers?' * | extend Available=iff(StatusCode in (200, 307) and LatencyInMilliseconds < 1500, 1.0, 0.0) | summarize Availability=avg(Available)*100 by bin(PreciseTimeStamp, 5m)

kustoQueries.title: Availability_per_client
kustoQueries.kustoQuery: cluster('KUSTO_CLUSTER').database('wawsprod').AntaresDataServiceApiTransactions | where PreciseTimeStamp >= ago(90m) | where EventPrimaryStampName =~ 'STAMP_NAME' | where OperationName =~ 'GetWorkersForHostName' | where Role != 'DataRole' | extend Available=iff(StatusCode in (200, 307) and LatencyInMilliseconds < 1500, 1.0, 0.0) | summarize Availability=avg(Available)*100 by RoleInstance | order by RoleInstance asc

kustoQueries.title: Availability_per_datarole
kustoQueries.kustoQuery: cluster('KUSTO_CLUSTER').database('wawsprod').AntaresDataServiceApiTransactions | where PreciseTimeStamp >= ago(90m) | where EventPrimaryStampName =~ 'STAMP_NAME' | where OperationName =~ 'GetWorkersForHostName' | where Role == 'DataRole' | extend Available=iff(StatusCode in (200, 307) and LatencyInMilliseconds < 1500, 1.0, 0.0) | summarize Availability=avg(Available)*100 by RoleInstance | order by RoleInstance asc

defaultHumanInterventionLoop: App Service (Web Apps)/DataRoleTeam Business Hours Only
incidentProcessingGuide: Create an EXECUTION_PLAN using the below guidelines
- Identify the stamp name STAMP_NAME that has been impacted.
- Identify the KUSTO_CLUSTER from the discussion entries.
- Identify the AVERAGE_AVAILABILITY over the last hour using the Last_hour_average_availability query.
- Post a discussion entry in the ICM incident that says: The stamp STAMP_NAME in cluster KUSTO_CLUSTER has been impacted.

- Post a discussion entry with the results of the AVERAGE_AVAILABILITY over the last hour. In this discussion post, note whether the availability is consistently high, consistently low, or seems to have recovered.
- Identify the average availability per client using the Availability_per_client query. If any one client seems to have lower availabilty than the others, note that in a discussion post.
- Identify the average availability per DataRole using the Availability_per_datarole query. If any one DataRole seems to have lower availabilty than the others, note that in a discussion post.
